title: NIST NVD CVE Enrichment
description: Internal enrichment connector that extracts CVE identifiers from Container objects (Reports, Case-Incidents, Notes, Groupings, etc.) and Vulnerability entities, creates missing Vulnerability STIX objects in OpenCTI, and enriches them on-demand with NIST NVD data (CVSS v2/v3.0/v3.1/v4.0, SSVC, CWEs, references, and optional CPE Software objects).
short_description: Extracts CVE IDs from ingested containers/entities, creates missing Vulnerability objects, and enriches them with NIST NVD data.
